entries.title: Infinitary chooses a crewmate’s model automatically
entries.body: Name a model for a task or pin models you want Infinitary to try first. If you had switched off Dynamic routing, your saved pins stay inactive until you restore them in Settings → Intelligence → Models. Your projects that ran at home still do. To let Infinitary choose the computer again, choose Automatic in Settings → Projects → Runs on.

picture.alt: Intelligence Settings explains automatic model choice under Models, beside the first mate’s separate model choice.
